reflection: Volume-based factors (Apple volume surge relative to NVDA/QQQ) repeatedly help in 2023 and 2025 but fail in 2022 and 2024; no pair has beaten the sum of its parts. Price-based relative moves and smoothing variants all failed. 2022 (bear, high vol) and 2024 (low vol bull) are the failure regimes, so I will try volume signals that are normalised by regime (longer baseline for Apple only, volume change rather than level) and new ideas using the up/down volume and range-expansion behaviours. Partners should supply a regime descriptor (QQQ trend/vol) to the volume signal.

lessons.name: aapl_vs_qqq_volume_surge_5d
lessons.lesson: Smoothing volume over 5 days against a 60d baseline made a slow level measure that lost the one-day attention spike and hurt in 3 of 4 years.

lessons.name: aapl_volume_vs_msft_nvda_volume
lessons.lesson: Averaging MSFT and NVDA volume z-scores as the benchmark diluted the NVDA-specific contrast and only helped LR, so the signal vanished.

lessons.name: aapl_volume_price_range_pressure
lessons.lesson: Multiplying volume z-score by daily range nearly duplicated volume_to_ma20 and gave strongly negative results in 2024.

lessons.name: msft_nvda_minus_qqq_5d
lessons.lesson: Peer 5d outperformance versus QQQ is largely a rescaled NVDA 5d return and its sign flips across regimes, so it hurt.

lessons.name: qqq_return_vs_aapl_vol_state
lessons.lesson: Dividing QQQ return by its own volatility is a near-copy of QQQ_return_1d and added nothing.

lessons.name: aapl_minus_qqq_gap_3d_mean
lessons.lesson: A 10d mean of Apple minus QQQ daily returns overlaps with Apple's own 10d mean return and its sign flips across regimes.

factors.name: aapl_vs_nvda_volume_change_1d
factors.hypothesis: The z-score versions depend on the 20d baseline whose scale differs between regimes (2022, 2024); a day-over-day log volume change difference removes the baseline and captures the pure attention shift Apple vs NVDA.

factors.name: aapl_vs_qqq_volume_surge_60d_base
factors.hypothesis: Failures in 2022 and 2024 probably come from both z-scores moving together with market-wide volume; using a slow QQQ baseline retains market-wide volume level info so the difference isolates Apple-specific surge versus the market state.

factors.name: aapl_down_volume_pressure
factors.hypothesis: Volume-weighted 5d return flow measures accumulation or distribution by Apple holders, which may predict continuation or reversal beyond plain returns.

factors.name: aapl_range_expansion_vs_5d
factors.hypothesis: Today's range relative to the recent average range signals volatility expansion or exhaustion, a different view than close-normalised daily range.

factors.name: qqq_trend_regime_20_60
factors.hypothesis: The volume signal flips between bear 2022 and bull years; a QQQ medium-term trend regime variable lets the model condition on that sign flip.

factors.name: aapl_minus_nvda_1d_return
factors.hypothesis: Apple's volume surge against the market combined with its same-day return gap versus NVDA, the highest-attention peer, may show whether the volume is rotation flow in or out of Apple.
